股权分配原则参考：\n 1. CEO 通常应持有最大股份（保持控制力与:
Equity allocation principles:
1. The CEO should usually hold the largest stake (to keep control and incentives).
2. Co-founders together ~60%–80%, leaving room for the option pool and funding.
3. 4-year vesting + 1-year cliff is standard, avoiding mid-exit equity loss.
4. Option pool ~10%–20%, set before funding to reduce later dilution.
5. Each round dilutes 15%–25%; over-dilution loses control.
6. Control red lines: 67% (absolute) / 51% (relative) / 34% (veto).
